speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I see you're an 8-month-old boy having trouble feeding and your tummy is very swollen. To help me understand what's wrong, can you tell me if you've been vomiting, especially if it looks like green or yellow fluid?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details. Since touching the belly worsens the crying, this suggests significant pain. Has there been any passage of stool, and if so, what color is it? Also, do you notice any "currant jelly" colored stool or blood?

REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Dilated bowel segments with absence of gas in the rectum, suggesting a possible obstruction

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Midgut Volvulus (likely due to malrotation).
